name: The majority voted in favour of a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2023-06-15.27.1) to keep item 9 in schedule 2 as it is. In parliamentary jargon, they voted that item 9 "stand as printed". This means it will remain unchanged. This was to make a minor amendment to [section 26](http://www5.austlii.edu.au/au/legis/cth/consol_act/pida2013295/s26.html) of the Public Interest Disclosure Act 2013. This vote took place after the Greens [proposed to oppose this item](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/display.w3p;query=Id%3A%22legislation%2Famend%2Fr6958_amend_e407f877-23a2-4879-bd5b-de2160704555%22;rec=0). ### What is item 9? > *9 Paragraph 26(1)(c)* > > *Omit “met:”, substitute “met.”.*
